model.title: Sparse-Attention Transformers for Multi-Horizon Monsoon Rainfall Forecasting Across the Western Ghats

paragraphs.text: Extreme monsoon rainfall along India’s Western Ghats triggers severe landslides and reservoir flash floods, yet 10-day operational numerical weather prediction grids at 25 km resolution smooth out steep terrain gradients.
Downscaling ERA5 reanalysis fields with full self-attention Transformers scales quadratically with spatial grid tokens, requiring 38.4 GB of VRAM for a 0.25 degree subcontinent domain.
We introduce MonsoonFormer, a multi-scale encoder-decoder that couples 3D atmospheric inputs (SST, U850, V850, Q850, SLP, Z500) with topographically aligned sparse attention windows.

Instead of attending over all 16,384 grid cells, each query token restricts key-value interaction to a 7x7 coastal-orographic neighborhood W(i) plus 128 strided synoptic anchor tokens, cutting attention complexity by 84%.
Heavy-tail monsoon extremes (>115.6 mm/day) are under-predicted by standard MSE objectives, so we combine pinball quantile loss with an orographic gradient penalty weighted by lambda = 0.35.
Evaluated on IMD 0.25-degree gridded rainfall across 2018-2023 JJAS seasons, MonsoonFormer lowers 5-day RMSE to 11.4 mm/day compared to 15.8 mm/day for ConvLSTM and 13.9 mm/day for PatchTST.

Critical Success Index (CSI) at the heavy-rainfall threshold (>64.5 mm/day) reaches 0.61 versus 0.44 for ConvLSTM and 0.54 for Full-Attention Transformer, while inference latency drops to 42 ms per forecast.

Key limitations remain: sparse local windows under-represent planetary Rossby wave coupling beyond day 7, and training relies strictly on historical ERA5 reanalysis without real-time Doppler radar assimilation.

claims.statement: MonsoonFormer reduces 5-day rainfall RMSE to 11.4 mm/day while cutting VRAM from 38.4 GB to 9.6 GB.
Sparse 7x7 coastal-orographic windows plus 128 synoptic anchor tokens cut attention complexity by 84%.
Composite Quantile-Hydrology Loss raises heavy-rainfall (>64.5 mm/day) CSI skill score to 0.61.

methodSteps.title: Atmospheric Grid Encoding
methodSteps.summary: Ingest SST, U850, V850, Q850, SLP, and Z500 ERA5 reanalysis fields at 0.25 degree resolution.

methodSteps.title: Sparse Orographic Attention
methodSteps.summary: Restrict attention keys to a 7x7 windward terrain neighborhood W(i) plus 128 strided synoptic anchors.

methodSteps.title: Quantile-Hydrology Optimization
methodSteps.summary: Train with pinball quantile loss plus elevation-gradient penalty weighted at lambda = 0.35.

limitations.statement: Sparse local windows under-represent planetary Rossby wave coupling beyond day 7.
Training uses historical ERA5 reanalysis without real-time Doppler radar assimilation.

glossary.definition: Rainfall forced when moist monsoon winds ascend steep coastal mountain slopes like the Western Ghats.
Verification metric measuring correctly forecast extreme rain events divided by hits, misses, and false alarms.

hardParts.term: Orographic rainfall smoothing in 25 km NWP grids
hardParts.reason: Requires physical context on how steep coastal topography triggers concentrated monsoon rain.
Readers need intuition for why CSI beats plain accuracy on rare extreme events.

hardParts.term: Sparse attention window vs planetary teleconnections
hardParts.reason: Technical trade-off between local window sparsity and long-range ENSO/Rossby wave propagation.

clarifications.title: Orographic Enhancement of Indian Summer Monsoon Rainfall along the Western Ghats
clarifications.quote: Moist low-level westerly jets forced over steep escarpments double local rainfall intensity relative to adjacent coastal plains.

clarifications.title: Global Teleconnections and Sparse Transformers in Subseasonal Forecasting (Rao et al.)
clarifications.quote: Local sparse windows degrade 10-to-14-day monsoon break predictions by severing tropical-extratropical Rossby wave links.

clarifications.title: Critical Success Index (Threat Score) in Meteorological Verification
clarifications.quote: CSI equals hits divided by hits plus misses plus false alarms, ignoring correct negatives in rare event verification.

clarifications.title: Practical GPU Memory Notes for Weather Transformers
clarifications.quote: Sparse window kernels typically save 70 to 85 percent memory compared with dense global attention.
